From the lead (2026-09-26): no core ticket is needed. Determinism is confirmed: library main has no parallel evaluation, fs2 steps sequentially, and the UI-C reduction sums in canonical order under an order-invariance law. Requirements for the generator:
(1) Pin the JDK and record it (vendor and version) in the SCORES.json receipt, because Math.exp/log can differ by an ulp across JVMs.
(2) Sort all output keys; never rely on HashMap iteration.
(3) Build against a locally published core at a SHA-stamped version, not the shared 0.0.0-workflow-slices.
It waits on UI-C landing.
